c1Heal.label: Constellation 1 ATK after healing
c1Heal.reason: A Constellation 1 party ATK bonus for 5 seconds after her Song heals, which depends on when the party is healed.

c4State.label: Constellation 4 Max HP stacks
c4State.reason: A Constellation 4 Max HP bonus that stacks as her Song heals party members at 40% HP or more, which builds up during the fight.

skillSong.label: Constellation 6 Song of Ages Past
skillSong.reason: With Constellation 6 her Skill starts the Song of Ages Past, which raises Hydro DMG while it lasts, so her Skill's later hits and the Burst cast inside it are counted with it, and the Burst deals more damage inside it.
